{
  "score": 3,
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "high",
      "line": 2436,
      "message": "CMBR-1 skip guard requires `_start_iter -gt 1`, so when a run is interrupted during iter 1 (`_persisted_iter=1` → `_start_iter=1`) the condition is false, `_cid_resume_first_iter` stays false, and already-complete cycle members in that iteration are re-dispatched instead of being skipped — the most common interruption point is unprotected.",
      "quote": "if [[ \"$iter\" -eq \"$_start_iter\" && \"$_start_iter\" -gt 1 ]]; then\n            _cid_resume_first_iter=true\n        fi",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "high",
      "line": 1866,
      "message": "The `iter > 0` guard fires unconditionally on every cycle member dispatch in every run (fresh and resume alike), because `iter` is sourced from `for (( iter=_start_iter; … ))` where `_start_iter >= 1` and `_cycle_iter_dispatch` is never called with `iter=0`; the design notes (Gap 7) explicitly flag this exact guard as WRONG, state it violates GUAR-1 by changing fresh-run event sequences, and require its removal — but it was not removed.",
      "quote": "if [[ \"$iter\" -gt 0 ]]; then\n            eb_emit_event \"stage.start\" \"stage=$s\" \\\n                || { local _r=$?; warn \"eb_emit_event stage.start failed (rc=$_r, continuing — disk/perm/lock?)\"; true; }\n        fi",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "tests/integration/resume-loop-state-test.sh",
      "category": "coverage",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 211,
      "message": "Every CMBR-1 assertion sets up `current_iter=2` (interrupted on iter 2); the case where a run is interrupted on iter 1 (`current_iter=1`, `_start_iter=1`) is never exercised, so the logic error in Finding 1 produces no test failure.",
      "quote": "zb_engine_loop_state \"$STATE_FILE\" \"build-test\" 2 5 \"in_progress\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "test"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "coverage",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 1866,
      "message": "No test asserts that `stage.start` is NOT emitted for cycle members on a fresh run, so the unconditional `stage.start` emission in Finding 2 is invisible to the test suite; GUAR-1 has no enforcing test on the cycle-member side.",
      "quote": "if [[ \"$iter\" -gt 0 ]]; then\n            eb_emit_event \"stage.start\" \"stage=$s\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "test"
    }
  ]
}
